newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian Indians gather for sports contest.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian Indians gather for sports contest.

text.p: Nearly 400 Indians from 34 Brazilian tribes gathered on Wednesday in the central city of Goiania for the opening of the Second Indigenous Peoples Games, organisers said.
The Indians, from the remote Yanomamis who live deep in the Amazon rainforest to the once mighty Guaranis from Brazil's south, were due to take part in four days of competition starting on Thursday.
Events include traditional sports like archery, wrestling and tug-of-war as well as modern games like soccer and volleyball.

Organisers said the aim of the games was to stimulate integration among Brazil's Indian groups, many of which are still struggling to survive nearly 400 years after the first colonialists arrived from Portugal.
They urged the government to complete demarcation of Indian reservations and stop loggers and farmers encroaching on Indian lands.
